summary: Azul S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release rather than any transactional event. Quarterly revenue was R$5.64 billion, EBITDA R$1.20 billion (21.4% margin), operating income R$560.1 million, and recurring free cash flow R$763.6 million; capacity fell 6.9% year over year while RASK and PRASK set records. Liquidity reached R$4.1 billion, or R$4.6 billion pro forma including American Airlines' US$100 million October equity investment. Management discusses post-restructuring performance, FNAC and FGE government-backed financings, not any acquisition, divestiture, tender, or go-private transaction.
